facts.fact: POTRAZ's Computer Incident Response Team, described as the national hub for detecting and coordinating responses to cyber incidents, handled incident reports in 2025, broken down as fraud 33%, cyberbullying 27%, hacking 17%, smishing 13% and theft 10%, per its Data Protection Officer.

ZWE.note: Figures are shares only, no count of incidents or alerts, so not recorded as published figures.

facts.fact: The document says Zimbabwe's Data Protection Act was enacted in 2021 and sets legal standards for handling personal data, with breach notification to POTRAZ within 24 hours.

POTRAZ is described as the body overseeing compliance under the Act, with powers to investigate breaches, issue enforcement notices and impose penalties, and as acting through its Data Protection Officer.
